domain_guidance.summary: This foundational domain covers the core principles, system architecture setups, and fundamental installation procedures required to properly deploy ServiceNow Robotic Process Automation for enterprise automation initiatives and workflows across organizations.

This specific domain focuses on designing, configuring, and deploying robots using official platform tools while clearly distinguishing between attended and unattended bot categories for robotic process automation workflows.

This domain explores the operational details and mechanical intricacies involved in bot run executions across the platform infrastructure to ensure smooth and reliable automated process delivery within enterprise environments.

This final domain explains how ServiceNow Robotic Process Automation integrates with core platform components and expertly manages exceptions within complex automated enterprise workflows, ensuring maximum reliability across diverse system environments.

editorial.overview: The ServiceNow Robotic Process Automation RPA certification assessment evaluates your knowledge of designing, configuring, and deploying automated bots across the platform. This linear format certification exam consists of exactly 35 total questions, spanning four distinct domains covering foundational principles, bot development lifecycles, execution mechanics, platform integration, and exception handling mechanisms.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully review official ServiceNow documentation, training courses, and learning paths before testing. Focus your study sessions extensively on bot development lifecycles, execution configuration, and error management strategies. Practice setting up robotic process automation components carefully and examine how they successfully integrate with existing platform elements and enterprise infrastructure.
editorial.who_should_take: ServiceNow developers and automation professionals configuring enterprise workflows will benefit from taking this exam. Experience with building bots and integrating automation components across platform systems is required.
